## Checklist

- [ ] One concern per PR; branch name and commits follow conventional commits
- [ ] No hard-coded colours, fonts or radii: design values come from tokens
- [ ] Accessible: keyboard reachable, visible focus, AA contrast, labelled controls
- [ ] All names, copy and images are fictional or properly licensed (no real salon brands)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data committed
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behaviour or commands changed
